scope: Prepared reporting implementation; final benchmark metrics are not yet available

known_execution_failure.interpretation: Affected full-denominator scores, contrasts and two-seed summaries describe execution outcomes, not clean estimates of model quality or training effects.

guard_checks.scope: Exact retained membership, explicit no-replay/empty outcomes, unchanged numeric values and affected comparisons

final_report_requires: Terminal results for all six models and both controls; exact evidence binding; visual inspection of real measured figures

paired_outcomes.correspondence: Same page, exact GT-index group and GT-text hash; require uniqueness in both outputs; duplicates/missing identities remain unmatchable

execution_timing: Separately report allocated GPU seconds, elapsed execution windows and occupied time unions; retain failures, waiting costs and missing timestamp dispositions.
